# Contributing

- Open an issue for a bug or a significant change. Use [Discussions](https://github.com/thinpack-js/thinpack.js/discussions) for questions.
- For compatibility changes, compare with Node.js. Keep artifacts small, reuse existing code, and test the behavior that changed.
- Run the relevant tests and `cargo xtask lint`. In the PR, say what changed, how you checked it, and whether it affects artifact size.
